modelReview.summary: The analysis lacks essential reporting elements: no confidence intervals, no description of cohort, no handling of confounding. Claims are limited but still misleading without these.

findings.title: No uncertainty estimates provided for cumulative incidence
findings.whyItMatters: Without confidence intervals, the precision and clinical meaning of the point estimates are unknown; the difference between treatments cannot be assessed.
findings.actionableFix: Compute and report 95% confidence intervals for the cumulative incidence functions, e.g., using log-log transformation or bootstrap.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check stats-run JSON for new field e.g., 'ci_lower', 'ci_upper'

findings.title: No description of the study cohort or dataset origin
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md:cohort construction lacks source, eligibility, definitions
findings.whyItMatters: The study cannot be evaluated for selection bias, generalizability, or reproducibility.
findings.actionableFix: Add a detailed cohort section: data source, study period, inclusion/exclusion criteria, definitions of treatment, competing events, event of interest.

findings.title: Observational comparison ignores confounding
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md:no covariates, no adjustment, no sensitivity analysis
findings.whyItMatters: Even a descriptive 'differ by treatment' statement implies a causal contrast; without addressing confounding, the comparison may be severely biased.
findings.actionableFix: Either adjust for confounders (e.g., via propensity scores or multivariable CIF regression) or explicitly state that only unadjusted crude estimates are presented and caution against causal interpretation.

findings.title: Complete-case analysis without missingness evaluation
findings.whyItMatters: If missingness is related to outcome or treatment, complete-case estimates can be biased.
findings.actionableFix: Report the number of records before exclusion, reasons for missingness, and consider multiple imputation or sensitivity analysis.

findings.title: No descriptive statistics for key variables
findings.whyItMatters: Readers cannot assess follow-up time, event counts, or censoring patterns, which are essential to interpret cumulative incidence.
findings.actionableFix: Add a table with number of events, median follow-up, number at risk at key timepoints, and treatment group sizes.

findings.title: Figure QA file truncated; cannot fully verify figure quality
findings.whyItMatters: The figure may contain errors not caught by automated checks.
findings.actionableFix: Complete the QA report and ensure the cumulative incidence plot axes, legend, and footnotes are accurate.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check for complete figure-qa.json with all checks passed.

missingEvidence: Baseline characteristics and treatment group sizes
Number of events (event of interest and competing) per group
Distribution of follow-up time and censoring
Confidence intervals for cumulative incidence estimates
Missingness analysis and initial sample size before exclusion
